name: EH3D-VALIDATION-LAB
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.2: early code. Test environment of the PHOENIX family: a Rust library and command line that write and verify the checksum manifest of a golden set against redundant copies, read results in which every failure carries a class, and compare a run with a baseline through a gate that a measured rate never drops. Reports hide the names of cases. It has only run on data made by its own tests; it reads no design file and the comparison with golden files, the case reducer and the invariant tests are planned.
